notes: Planned test IDs are executable assertion identifiers (<test file>::<assertion>); they are not executed evidence.
Every row is mandatory. Absent, unrun, failed or unverified-artifact assertions remain unvalidated.
Fixture IDs resolve through tests/fixtures/manifest.json; oracle text is the independent expected result to assert.

Only tests/desktop/images.spec.ts::SC-006-timing (latency budgets) and the visual.spec.ts image cases (pixel mismatch) are informational, per tests/desktop/qa-classification.ts; every other assertion is critical.

rows.oracle: Activating Image opens a chooser limited to PNG and JPEG; cancelling it leaves the report bytes unchanged, no dirty tab and no undo entry (the next insertion is the first and only history step).
tests: apps/vscode-extension/src/image-import.test.ts::a cancelled chooser stops before any file access

rows.oracle: A valid PNG or JPEG adds one EmbeddedImages collection (when absent), one definition and one Embedded FitProportional image item at the default or drop position; the item is selected and the document is dirty; every other byte is unchanged.
tests: packages/xml-serializer/src/images.test.ts::creates EmbeddedImages as the last child of Report when it is absent
apps/vscode-extension/src/image-import.test.ts::a new picture adds one definition and one FitProportional item

rows.oracle: The inserted picture is decoded and painted inside the item bounds; the default size is the natural pixel size at 96 dpi (90pt x 30pt for the 120 x 40 px logo), reduced to the body width keeping the aspect ratio.
tests: apps/vscode-extension/src/image-import.test.ts::the size is the natural pixel size at 96 DPI in inches
packages/renderer/src/render.test.ts::authored images render as picture items keyed by the definition hash

rows.oracle: One Undo removes both the item and the definition it introduced and the report text equals the original bytes; one Redo restores both exactly.

A damaged picture is refused with its file name and reason in the designer; the report bytes and the undo history are unchanged and no picture data appears in the message. Wrong signature, truncation, size, pixel and budget refusals are covered below the desktop.
